Practical safety: a 14-16 July 2026 wave of vigilante mob attacks on trans women — most severely more than fifteen people doused, stripped and beaten in Bogor, with footage circulated online — shows mob violence met with limited accountability. Documents: legal gender change requires sex-reassignment surgery plus judicial approval. Marriage relevance: the 2022 penal-code amendment criminalising sex outside marriage, in force from 2 January 2026 with up to one year in prison, is the marriage-adjacent exposure for unmarried partners travelling together. Nothing in the audited material shows Gorontalo diverging in either direction: no local ordinance, raid wave, protection or service specific to the province is documented.

Parent-nation posture: the same feature records provincial moral enforcement as sharpest in Aceh — the one province where homosexuality is illegal under Sharia (religious) law with flogging or imprisonment — a comparative outlier that does not reach Gorontalo.
